limitations: Held-out goal orbits exclude this continuation; the inherited 1000/2000 checkpoints already saw all near targets.
Fresh relation cohorts avoid the reconstructed continuation label/axis closure, not every historical pretraining label.
Micro development start stars avoid micro training stars; main pilot guarantees relation/axis exclusion, not globally unseen physical states.
The main arms match full-star and goal exposure, but not the number of nontrivial strict-order constraints; far layers can have all six actions optimal.
Micro training error still decreases at its budget boundary; failure to fit is not proof of impossibility for 128-D Linf or this network.
Full protected-path diagnostics and sealed tests were evaluated only after selection was frozen; none caused subsequent training or reselection.
